_comment: Per-language preferred translations. Soft guidance injected into the prompt: the model still inflects each term to the correct grammatical form for its context. Add entries under a locale to enforce consistent terminology, then re-run: node translate-messages.mjs --language <loc> --fresh (optionally --scope <ns>). Remove the _comment key if your tooling is strict about it — translate-messages.mjs ignores unknown locale keys.
